models_source: corrected-v3 frozen manifest; all five required

calibration.protocol_rule: Separate protocol and output per arm; both identities in each arm. No global budget multiplier and no principal score.
calibration.selection_rule: Freeze the smallest common budget before held-out evaluation that avoids truncating reference development workflows. Publish all cells and failures; never tune a per-model budget to make a candidate pass.

skills_ablation.inference_unit: task; average repetitions within each task before paired contrasts

inference_diagnostics.speculation: off; any later experiment requires a separate protocol and parity check

heldout_rule: Reserve independent, oracle-validated task variants before calibration; do not modify prompts or policy after inspecting held-out results.
publication_gate: Exact coverage, versions and effective settings, raw trajectories, graded verdicts, resource envelope, failure taxonomy and denominators must be available. No general winner from M1 alone.
